(2) SEC-LOG-001 (high, REWORK, action CONNECT_LOGS_TO_SIEM): logs_to_siem=false and sentinel=false; corroborated by authoritative SENTINEL_STATUS (no connectors). (3) SEC-KEY-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS, action IMPROVE_KEY_ROTATION, risk acceptance allowed): key_rotation_days=null; corroborated by authoritative KEYVAULT_CONFIG. No other candidate finding triggers: private_endpoints=true despite Confidential classification (no SEC-NET-001; AZURE_RESOURCE_GRAPH shows SQL MI/Storage/Key Vault with publicNetworkAccess=false); mfa="mandatory" (no SEC-IAM-001; CONDITIONAL_ACCESS confirms); shared_service_principal=false (no SEC-IAM-002; IAM_EXPORT shows only a dedicated ManagedIdentity); critical_vulns_open=0 (no SEC-VULN-001; DEFENDER_FINDINGS shows only a closed Low finding — note 9 high vulns remain open, to be tracked by the Product Team but no rule predicate applies); pentest_status="pass" and phase is design, not build_acceptance (no SEC-PENTEST-001); waf_present=false so detection-mode SEC-WAF-002 cannot trigger. NO_GO is the highest-priority triggered disposition because SEC-WAF-001 cannot be risk-accepted; the internet-facing workload must gain a WAF (in prevention mode) before the gate can pass. Authorization is required for NO_GO. This decision addresses the submitted security snapshot only; upstream procurement NO_GO (PROC-MAND-001), legal SUSPENSION (LEGAL-INS-001), and compliance NO_GO (COMP-RESID-001) remain separate, already-produced decisions. Proposed actions are not completed remediation.

(1) IT-CATALOG-001 (high, REWORK, action SUBMIT_TECHNOLOGY_WAIVER, owner IT Architecture, risk acceptance not allowed): catalog_status="non_standard" with waiver_present=false; TECH_CATALOG is unavailable, but the review snapshot is the authoritative source for this gate and no approved waiver exists.
